Panda Express has Wok Wednesday with free  food. Also, get a plate with 2 entrees and a side for about $10.

Plates Offers At Panda Express

Panda Express has Plates that come with 2 or 3 entrees plus a side dish. Pick your entrees and side and make your own masterpiece! Plates with 2 entrees start around $10 and may cost more depending on your location.  Some entrees have an upcharge, like steak.

Regular plates start at around $9.50.  Bigger Plates (with 3 entrees) start around $11.50.

Panda Express Rewards

Panda Express recently launched a new Rewards program. You can sign up for rewards here on the Panda Express website here and start earning the goodies. You’ll get a free Birthday Gift, a Good Fortune Gift with your first purchase every month, points towards free food on regular purchases and more exclusive perks.

Panda Express Lunar New Year Specials

Panda Express has its annual Lunar New Year celebration going through February 22, with coupons like buy one get one free entrees or free egg rolls. Head to the Panda Express Lunar New Year page here for a virtual scratch-off game for coupons, plus the chance to learn some fun facts about Chinese New Year along the way. There are some big prizes up for grabs, too, like an $888 gift card!

Panda Express Family Meals

The Family Meal from Panda Express gets you 3 Large Entrees, 2 Large Sides and can feed 4-6 people for $35.  Some entrees have an upcharge.  Entrees include:

Is There A Panda Express Near Me?

Panda Express has approximately 2,200 locations in the U.S. You can find the Panda Express location near you at: Panda Express Near Me

OrderChinese Takeout

What Are Panda Express Hours?

Most Panda Express locations open around 10:30 – 11 am for lunch and dinner, closing around 9 or 10 pm, but times can vary. To find the hours, address and more details for your Panda Express, select your location from: Panda Express Near Me

How Do I Order Panda Express Delivery?

Panda Express offers delivery from many locations, mostly with a flat fee of $3.99.  To place a delivery order, click here for the Panda Express delivery page and click “Order Now”.

You can also place a delivery order through the Panda Express app – click here and scroll to the bottom of the page to download it for Apple or Android.

Where Do I Find Panda Express Nutritional Info?

Panda Express lists food allergen and nutritional information in their online and app menus.  To view the nutritional content of any menu item, click here for the Panda Express Nutrition webpage.
